summary: This Form 6-K filing by Ternium S.A., a Luxembourg-based foreign private issuer, contains the company's consolidated condensed interim financial statements for the quarter ended March 31, 2026, and the comparable prior-year period. The filing reports routine financial results including net sales, operating income, and profit attributable to owners of the parent. It does not announce any corporate event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private transaction, spin-off, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, capital return, rights offering, activist campaign, strategic review, SPAC transaction, management change, or deal termination. The filing is a periodic report of financial results with no disclosure of a special situation. As a foreign private issuer report submitted under Rule 13a-16, it is equivalent to a domestic Form 10-Q or earnings release and does not trigger a special-situations classification. The single unusual item is a provision for ongoing litigation related to the acquisition of a participation in Usiminas, but this is a legacy legal accrual, not a new event.
